## **Pression publicitaire** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Pression publicitaire.**
      1 avis récent mentionne pression publicitaire.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 22 août 2026 - 22 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs remarquent la pression publicitaire. Cela signale une friction de monétisation et une ouverture pour un concurrent plus propre.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Veeresh G_, 22 août 2026, 5/5: "Google Fit is an amazing health and fitness tracking app! It helps you track daily steps, workouts, and heart points easily. It runs smoothly with zero ads, helping you stay motivated and healthy every day. ಗೂಗಲ್ ಫಿಟ್ ದೈನಂದಿನ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಫಿಟ್‌ನೆಸ್ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಗೆ ಅತ್ಯುತ್ತಮ ಆ್ಯಪ್! ಇದು ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳ ಎಣಿಕೆ, ವರ್ಕೌಟ್‌ಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಹಾರ್ಟ್ ಪಾಯಿಂಟ್ಸ್ ಅನ್ನು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಟ್ರ್ಯಾಕ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಯಾವುದೇ ಜಾಹೀರಾತುಗಳ ಕಿರಿಕಿರಿಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ, ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಆರೋಗ್ಯವಾಗಿರಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 5 août 2026 - 20 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Simon_, 5 août 2026, 1/5: "broken af. the entire screen keeps loading forever when the app has no internet even tho i know exactly what it should be showing me but its just UNUSABLE if it doesmt habe internet Access 24/7"
            2. _Abhiram Nair_, 20 août 2026, 2/5: "I use my samsung watch for logging my daily activities and via health connect data is set to sync with google fit. but none of my workouts are logged in and i got 0 heart points for every day. while sleep and other data are synced correctly. please fix this bug"
            3. _Karthik Rajamani_, 19 août 2026, 2/5: "From the latest update I see a bug. if I have a smart device like a smartwatch also tracking the steps and when I connect it and sync it up with my Google account then what is measured by Google fit and the watch in terms of the number of steps gets added for the same distance. It shows as double the value for the same walk. Earlier it was not adding it but taking the larger of the two values. For example if I have covered 5000 steps, Google fit counts both the inputs and shows as 10000 steps"
<!--/ir-theme-->
